metadata.title: Docetaxel, Carboplatin, Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab (TCHP) Therapy
metadata.indication: Neoadjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.
metadata.source_title_exact: DOCEtaxel, CARBOplatin, Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab (TCHP) Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

validation.source_method: Official web-extracted NCCP PDF text and page/table review; not an independent human clinical sign-off.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Source/software review does not establish clinical authorisation.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: Neoadjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.

options.label: Neoadjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.

gcsf_strategy.label: Haematological management strategy
gcsf_strategy.help: The source provides alternative dose-reduction and G-CSF strategies.

gfr_ml_min.label: GFR (mL/min)

renal_input.reason: Required for carboplatin Calvert dosing and renal safety assessment.

gfr_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Enter the verified continuous GFR/CrCl used for carboplatin dosing. The app will apply encoded renal thresholds; confirm the Calvert calculation and local dosing policy independently.

bilirubin_abnormal.label: Bilirubin above the laboratory normal range

lvef_drop_points.label: Absolute LVEF fall from pretreatment value (percentage points)

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and/or motor symptoms and their effect on instrumental versus self-care activities of daily living. Distinguish transient cold sensitivity from persistent functional neuropathy.

stomatitis_grade.label: Stomatitis grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

stomatitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Inspect the oral cavity and assess pain, ulceration, diet modification and whether oral intake is impaired.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Hypersensitivity / anaphylaxis grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild hypersensitivity for which systemic intervention is not indicated; anaphylaxis has no Grade 1 criterion.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Oral intervention indicated for allergic/hypersensitivity symptoms; anaphylaxis has no Grade 2 criterion.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Bronchospasm, urticaria with systemic features, angioedema or hypotension requiring parenteral intervention and/or hospitalisation.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening airway or haemodynamic consequences; urgent intervention required.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess bronchospasm, urticaria, angioedema, hypotension, airway compromise, treatment route and hospitalisation. Anaphylaxis or life-threatening hypersensitivity requires immediate emergency treatment.

severe_infusion_reaction.label: Severe infusion reaction requiring urgent treatment

weeks_since_last_dose.label: Weeks since last HER2 antibody infusion

options.label: After chemotherapy: confirm selected HER2 regimen

renal_input.reason: The exact percentage relative to the isotope-GFR reference creatinine identifies whether repeat measurement is required; this is not an eGFR dose band.

action.recommendation: Do not administer TCHP; obtain consultant review.

rules.explanation: Relevant hypersensitivity is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Do not administer TCHP during pregnancy or breastfeeding; urgent consultant review required.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy and breastfeeding are exclusions.

action.recommendation: Do not proceed with HER2-directed treatment without consultant/cardiology review.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Withhold treatment and assess/treat the infection before proceeding.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant infection requires review before systemic treatment.

action.recommendation: Baseline LVEF must be at least55% under NCCP00722; no post-anthracycline50% exception is printed. Review with oncology/cardiology before initiation.

rules.explanation: Baseline LVEF must be at least55% under NCCP00722; no post-anthracycline50% exception is printed. Review with oncology/cardiology before initiation.

action.recommendation: Baseline grade 2 or greater sensory/motor neuropathy is an exclusion for this regimen.

rules.explanation: Baseline grade 2 or greater neuropathy is excluded.

action.recommendation: Delay docetaxel and carboplatin for low counts. Enter the selected haematological management strategy to refine the post-recovery dose plan.

rules.explanation: ANC below 1.0 or platelets 100 or below requires an immediate treatment delay; the selected G-CSF or dose-reduction pathway refines subsequent dosing.

action.recommendation: Give 75% docetaxel and carboplatin according to the dose-reduction pathway.

rules.explanation: ANC 1.0–1.49 with platelets >100 uses 75% doses in the dose-reduction pathway.

action.recommendation: The encoded G-CSF option permits 100% regimen with G-CSF support; confirm the selected strategy with the consultant.

rules.explanation: The source includes a 100% regimen plus G-CSF option.

action.recommendation: Delay until ANC >1.5 and platelets >100, then give 75% docetaxel and carboplatin.

rules.explanation: Low Day 1 counts require delay and 75% dosing in the dose-reduction pathway.

action.recommendation: Delay until ANC >1.5 and platelets >100, then resume 100% regimen with the selected G-CSF strategy.

rules.explanation: Low Day 1 counts require delay before the 100% plus G-CSF option.

action.recommendation: For a first febrile-neutropenia event, give 75% of the previous cycle dose when counts have recovered.

rules.explanation: First febrile-neutropenia event: 75% dose-reduction option.

action.recommendation: For a second febrile-neutropenia event, give 50% of the original cycle dose when counts have recovered.

rules.explanation: Second febrile-neutropenia event: 50% of original dose.

action.recommendation: Discontinue the regimen or switch to the G-CSF pathway after a third febrile-neutropenia event.

rules.explanation: Third event: discontinue or switch strategy.

action.recommendation: After a first febrile-neutropenia event and count recovery, give 100% of the regimen using the G-CSF pathway.

rules.explanation: First event in the G-CSF option retains 100% regimen dosing.

action.recommendation: After a second febrile-neutropenia event and count recovery, give 75% of the regimen using the G-CSF pathway.

rules.explanation: Second event in the G-CSF option uses 75% regimen dosing.

action.recommendation: After a third febrile-neutropenia event and count recovery, give 50% of the regimen using the G-CSF pathway.

rules.explanation: Third event in the G-CSF option uses 50% regimen dosing.

action.recommendation: Do not administer carboplatin when GFR is 20 mL/min or less.

rules.explanation: Carboplatin should not be administered at GFR ≤20 mL/min.

action.recommendation: Carboplatin requires extreme caution at GFR >20 to 30 mL/min; obtain consultant/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: The source advises extreme caution at GFR 20–30 mL/min.

action.recommendation: Delay chemotherapy for up to 2 weeks for abnormal bilirubin; if no recovery, stop chemotherapy. Trastuzumab may continue after consultant review.

rules.explanation: Abnormal bilirubin requires chemotherapy delay and reassessment.

action.recommendation: Reduce docetaxel from 75 to 60 mg/m².

rules.explanation: AST/ALT >2.5–5×ULN with alkaline phosphatase ≤2.5×ULN requires docetaxel 60 mg/m².

action.recommendation: Reduce docetaxel from 75 to 60 mg/m².

rules.explanation: Combined transaminase and alkaline-phosphatase elevation requires docetaxel 60 mg/m².

action.recommendation: Delay chemotherapy for a maximum of 2 weeks; discontinue chemotherapy if values do not recover.

rules.explanation: The explicit Table 5 combination of AST/ALT >5×ULN and alkaline phosphatase >5×ULN requires delay.

action.recommendation: This liver-test combination is not explicitly tabulated in Table 5; obtain consultant/pharmacy review before chemotherapy.

rules.explanation: Avoid extrapolating an unlisted hepatic combination.

action.recommendation: This liver-test combination is not explicitly tabulated in Table 5; obtain consultant/pharmacy review before chemotherapy.

rules.explanation: Avoid extrapolating an unlisted hepatic combination.

action.recommendation: Withhold trastuzumab and pertuzumab for at least 3 weeks and repeat LVEF assessment.

rules.explanation: LVEF <50% with a fall of at least 10 points requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Discontinue trastuzumab and pertuzumab for symptomatic heart failure and obtain urgent cardiology review.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic heart failure requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Discontinue HER2-directed treatment for grade 4 hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Reduce docetaxel to 60 mg/m² for grade >2 peripheral neuropathy.

rules.explanation: Grade >2 neuropathy requires docetaxel reduction to 60 mg/m².

action.recommendation: Discontinue docetaxel if grade >2 neuropathy continues at 60 mg/m².

rules.explanation: Persistent grade >2 neuropathy at 60 mg/m² requires docetaxel discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Reduce docetaxel to 60 mg/m² for grade 3 or greater stomatitis.

rules.explanation: Grade ≥3 stomatitis requires docetaxel reduction.

action.recommendation: Reduce docetaxel from 60 to 50 mg/m²; no further reduction is planned.

rules.explanation: Recurrent grade ≥3 stomatitis at 60 mg/m² requires reduction to 50 mg/m².

action.recommendation: Outside the source performance-status range; oncology review of suitability is required.

rules.explanation: Outside the source performance-status range; oncology review of suitability is required.

action.recommendation: Confirm validated HER2-positive disease before this HER2-directed regimen.

rules.explanation: Confirm validated HER2-positive disease before this HER2-directed regimen.

action.recommendation: Stop the infusion and urgently manage the reaction; specialist review is required before any re-exposure.

rules.explanation: Stop the infusion and urgently manage the reaction; specialist review is required before any re-exposure.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue pertuzumab for infusion-related bronchospasm/ARDS; urgently manage the reaction and review the other components separately.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue pertuzumab for infusion-related bronchospasm/ARDS; urgently manage the reaction and review the other components separately.

action.recommendation: Assess resting dyspnoea urgently before infusion; the source identifies increased risk of fatal trastuzumab infusion reactions in this setting.

rules.explanation: Assess resting dyspnoea urgently before infusion; the source identifies increased risk of fatal trastuzumab infusion reactions in this setting.

action.recommendation: If trastuzumab is discontinued, pertuzumab must also be discontinued.

rules.explanation: If trastuzumab is discontinued, pertuzumab must also be discontinued.

action.recommendation: The source excludes pretreatment ANC below 1.5; distinguish this from subsequent-cycle adjustment options.

rules.explanation: The source excludes pretreatment ANC below 1.5; distinguish this from subsequent-cycle adjustment options.

action.recommendation: Uncontrolled hypertension is a source exclusion; correct/review before treatment.

rules.explanation: Uncontrolled hypertension is a source exclusion; correct/review before treatment.

action.recommendation: The source table leaves exact ANC 1.5, platelets 100 and the decimal interval above ANC 1.49 unassigned. Resolve with consultant/pharmacy; do not silently use a full-dose or delay row.

rules.explanation: The source table leaves exact ANC 1.5, platelets 100 and the decimal interval above ANC 1.49 unassigned. Resolve with consultant/pharmacy; do not silently use a full-dose or delay row.

action.recommendation: ANC is in the source adjustment band. Confirm platelets and choose the consultant-approved dose-reduction or G-CSF pathway; no automatic full dose.

rules.explanation: ANC is in the source adjustment band. Confirm platelets and choose the consultant-approved dose-reduction or G-CSF pathway; no automatic full dose.

action.recommendation: Low LVEF needs prompt cardiac review; establish the absolute fall from pretreatment before applying the two-part withholding rule.

rules.explanation: Low LVEF needs prompt cardiac review; establish the absolute fall from pretreatment before applying the two-part withholding rule.

action.recommendation: Grade >2 neuropathy needs docetaxel adjustment. Establish the current dose; ongoing toxicity at 60 mg/m² requires discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Grade >2 neuropathy needs docetaxel adjustment. Establish the current dose; ongoing toxicity at 60 mg/m² requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Severe stomatitis needs review of the actual docetaxel dose. The source provides 75→60→50 mg/m² and no further reduction.

rules.explanation: Severe stomatitis needs review of the actual docetaxel dose. The source provides 75→60→50 mg/m² and no further reduction.

action.recommendation: A ≥6-week gap requires the source reloading schedule for both HER2 antibodies. Confirm the administration record and current prescription.

rules.explanation: A ≥6-week gap requires the source reloading schedule for both HER2 antibodies. Confirm the administration record and current prescription.

action.recommendation: Establish current count recovery and the chosen G-CSF strategy before applying a post-febrile-neutropenia dose. No dose is inferred from event number alone.

rules.explanation: Establish current count recovery and the chosen G-CSF strategy before applying a post-febrile-neutropenia dose. No dose is inferred from event number alone.

action.recommendation: The source stops docetaxel when grade >2 neuropathy persists at 60 mg/m²; there is no supported further neuropathy reduction at an already lower 50 mg/m² dose. Obtain specialist review.

rules.explanation: The source stops docetaxel when grade >2 neuropathy persists at 60 mg/m²; there is no supported further neuropathy reduction at an already lower 50 mg/m² dose. Obtain specialist review.

action.recommendation: The source generally delays the other drugs when docetaxel is delayed, while its bilirubin paragraph allows trastuzumab continuation after review. Confirm explicitly whether each HER2 antibody is held; chemotherapy delay does not automatically clear antibodies.

rules.explanation: The source generally delays the other drugs when docetaxel is delayed, while its bilirubin paragraph allows trastuzumab continuation after review. Confirm explicitly whether each HER2 antibody is held; chemotherapy delay does not automatically clear antibodies.

action.recommendation: Baseline LVEF<55% is outside the source initiation threshold.

rules.explanation: Baseline LVEF<55% is outside the source initiation threshold.

action.recommendation: Unrecognised stage: select Before starting or During treatment. Independent safety findings still apply.

rules.explanation: Unrecognised stage: select Before starting or During treatment. Independent safety findings still apply.

action.recommendation: Unrecognised phase: identify active medicines before applying dosing rules.

rules.explanation: Unrecognised phase: identify active medicines before applying dosing rules.

action.recommendation: Chemotherapy is complete or a postoperative phase is proposed. Confirm the separately selected HER2 regimen for its own assessment, monitoring and support; do not carry chemotherapy dose actions forward.

rules.explanation: Chemotherapy is complete or a postoperative phase is proposed. Confirm the separately selected HER2 regimen for its own assessment, monitoring and support; do not carry chemotherapy dose actions forward.

action.recommendation: Review the historical initiation measurement without treating it as the current on-treatment LVEF. Current LVEF, change and symptoms determine ongoing actions.

rules.explanation: Review the historical initiation measurement without treating it as the current on-treatment LVEF. Current LVEF, change and symptoms determine ongoing actions.

action.recommendation: Confirm whether this is baseline or ongoing LVEF: the initiation threshold differs from on-treatment hold criteria. Missing context is not clearance.

rules.explanation: Confirm whether this is baseline or ongoing LVEF: the initiation threshold differs from on-treatment hold criteria. Missing context is not clearance.

action.recommendation: Obtain current LVEF to interpret the decline. The source ongoing hold requires both LVEF<50% and decline≥10points.

rules.explanation: Obtain current LVEF to interpret the decline. The source ongoing hold requires both LVEF<50% and decline≥10points.

action.recommendation: Obtain change from baseline and review symptoms; missing change cannot establish the exact on-treatment criterion.

rules.explanation: Obtain change from baseline and review symptoms; missing change cannot establish the exact on-treatment criterion.

action.recommendation: Printed count table uses strict >1.5 and >100. Exact boundary requires source/consultant clarification rather than automatic full-dose clearance.

rules.explanation: Printed count table uses strict >1.5 and >100. Exact boundary requires source/consultant clarification rather than automatic full-dose clearance.

action.recommendation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing: initiation excludes ANC<1.5, while later treatment has a source-specific strategy.

rules.explanation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing: initiation excludes ANC<1.5, while later treatment has a source-specific strategy.

action.recommendation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing neuropathy. Source baseline exclusion and later modification thresholds differ.

rules.explanation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing neuropathy. Source baseline exclusion and later modification thresholds differ.

action.recommendation: Confirm the creatinine result was obtained within 48 hours before carboplatin when using an estimated GFR. A missing timestamp is not a fresh result.

rules.explanation: Confirm the creatinine result was obtained within 48 hours before carboplatin when using an estimated GFR. A missing timestamp is not a fresh result.

action.recommendation: Confirm measured isotope versus estimated GFR before interpreting this renal context. Estimated dosing needs creatinine within 48 hours; a rise above 110% of isotope-reference creatinine requires consideration of repeat or estimated GFR.

rules.explanation: Confirm measured isotope versus estimated GFR before interpreting this renal context. Estimated dosing needs creatinine within 48 hours; a rise above 110% of isotope-reference creatinine requires consideration of repeat or estimated GFR.
rules.encoding_note: Context clarification; no invented numeric restart dose.

rules.explanation: Estimated-GFR dosing requires creatinine obtained within 48 hours.

action.recommendation: Creatinine clearance below 60 increases myelosuppression risk; review the dose and monitoring.

rules.explanation: Creatinine clearance below 60 increases myelosuppression risk; review the dose and monitoring.

action.recommendation: No recovery after maximum two-week hepatic delay: discontinue chemotherapy and separately review HER2 continuation.

action.recommendation: Current febrile neutropenia: urgent assessment/treatment; historic event-number restart rules do not authorise treatment during active FN.

action.recommendation: Required echo/MUGA missing or overdue: arrange assessment and a documented clinical decision; do not infer normal function.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded contraindication, hold, dose-modification or treatment-context criterion was triggered. Complete normal prescribing, clinical and pharmacy checks.
output_templates.coverage_gap: One or more potentially relevant protocol domains were not assessed.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: TCH/TCHP carboplatin combination uses the specific AUC≥4 plan. Continuation follows the selected medicine; do not assume every postoperative HER2 medicine is minimal risk.
